newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to allow suspended firms to trade stocks.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to allow suspended firms to trade stocks.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Wednesday he would allow suspended firms which operated both finance and securities business to resume securities business.
He said the Bank of Thailand would be in charge to make sure that the two sides of the businesses were completely separated.
"We had receive the proposal from the suspended companies and will make that happen as soon as possible," Thanong told reporters.
The Bank of Thailand on Tuesday suspended troubled 42 financial companies on the top of 16 companies already suspended in June.
The move is to restore confidence to the ailing financial sector by clearly separating the good from bad financial insitutions.
Among the 42 companies suspended, more than half were companies that operated both finance and securities business while the authorities wanted to suspend only their finance operation.
